title: Untargeted Metabolite Analysis of Hydrolysate via LC/MS
author: Akila Wijerathna Yapa

steps.title: Sample Reconstitution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the powdered hydrolysate sample in deionized water to a final concentration of 1 µg/µL.

substeps.instruction: Add deionized water to reach 1 µg/µL concentration.

steps.title: Prepare LC/MS Instrument
steps.instruction: Set up the QExactive mass spectrometer interfaced with a Vanquish liquid chromatography system using a Zorbax SB-CN Rapid Resolution HD column (1.8 µm, 2.1 × 150 mm, Agilent).

substeps.instruction: Prepare Mobile phase A (0.1% formic acid in water) and Mobile phase B (0.1% formic acid in methanol).
Configure gradient elution: 1% B for 2 min; ramp to 15% B over 10 min; increase to 60% B in 3 min; ramp to 100% B in 4.9 min and hold for 2 min; return to 1% B in 0.1 min and hold for 5 min.
Set MS1 parameters: Resolution 35,000, AGC target 3e6, max injection time 100 ms, scan range 75–900 m/z, profile mode.
Set MS2 parameters: Resolution 17,500, AGC target 1e5, max injection time 50 ms, isolation window 2 m/z, loop count 10, normalized collision energy 20 and 35, scan range 200–2000 m/z, centroid mode.

Set Ion Source: Positive spray voltage 3,700 V, negative spray voltage -3,500 V, capillary temperature 300°C, sheath gas 45, auxiliary gas 15, spare gas 2, S-Lens RF level 45, probe heater temperature 250°C.

steps.title: Sample Dilution
steps.instruction: Dilute the reconstituted sample for mass spectrometry analysis.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 10 µL of the reconstituted sample to an MS-suitable vial.
Dilute with 40 µL of deionized water.

steps.title: Metabolite Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract metabolites from the reconstituted hydrolysate solution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 60 µL of the reconstituted hydrolysate solution into a microcentrifuge tube.
Add 240 µL of extraction solution (40:40:20 methanol/acetonitrile/1% formic acid).
Add 3 µL of a 2X diluted isotope-labeled amino acid standard (e.g., Cambridge Isotopes, CAT#MSK-A2).

steps.title: Drying and Reconstitution
steps.instruction: Dry the extract and reconstitute for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Dry the collected supernatant in a SpeedVac centrifuge until completely desiccated.
Reconstitute the dried extract in 100 µL of deionized water.

steps.title: Data Acquisition
steps.instruction: Perform untargeted metabolomics analysis using a data-dependent acquisition scheme.

substeps.instruction: Apply dynamic exclusion settings of 10 seconds.
